asr.full_text: A. The Affiliate Program Mirror Trading International offers 2 Affiliate Rewards 10% direct referral bonus 20% weekly profit sharing bonus this is the residual income opportunity All bonuses come from daily trading income, and are therefore financially sustainable you will earn a 10% referral bonus for every member you personally introduce to Meru Trading International and also for any amounts they add over and above their original investment. Free members, or people who have not funded their accounts, do not quantify to earn 10% direct referral bonuses. 20% of daily income results are allocated to the weekly Binary Profit Sharing Pool. The binary structure works as follows. You can recruit new members into your left or right leg. To qualify for binary bonuses, you will also need a minimum amount of $200 in the trading pool and you will need to have personally recruited one new member in your left and one in your right leg. The third person you personally introduce will become spill over for one of the people you introduced before as you can only place in your left or right side. Spillover will also occur if your sponsor or team members above you introduce people into a leg 20% of the income from the week's trading will be shared according to the Bitcoin value of your weaker leg. When you are binary qualified with $200 to $999 in your personal account, this will allow you to earn up to 10 levels in the binary. As your team grows, you can increase your amount in trade so that you can qualify to earn on more levels. With $1,000 to $4,999 in the pool, you will receive bonuses up to 20 levels deep. Accounts with $5,000 to $9,999 will receive bonuses up to 30 levels deep, and with $10,000 and above, you'll receive bonuses on infinite levels of the binary structure in your weakest leg. Binary bonuses are paid every week on the B basis. With these additional benefits, you do not have to pay any more money to get a fuller business. It also allows you to invest on infinite levels of the binary structure in your weakest leg. Binary bonuses are paid every week on the bitcoin value in your weaker leg, creating your weekly residual income. All referral and binary bonuses cap of $ 15,000 per day and $75,000 per week. Mirror Trading International is a real company and if there are no trading profits there can be no income or bonuses. Mirror Trading International is the opportunity we have all been looking for. Join us today, build your business and begin the journey to financial freedom. If you have questions or for more information please contact Clint.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes participation in a binary recruitment structure where members must fund a trading account and recruit people into left and right legs to qualify for bonuses. It presents weekly residual income, deeper earning levels tied to larger account amounts, and financial freedom as benefits, then directs viewers to contact a named person to join. The combination of recruitment-dependent compensation, required funding, and passive-income promises makes the central communication an earning solicitation rather than a neutral explanation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promoted earnings depend on a multi-person left/right binary hierarchy, spillover, sponsor/team placement, and qualification across increasing levels. S03 is additionally supported because participation is linked to weekly profit-sharing and residual income from a purported trading pool, although the recruitment matrix is the primary mechanism.
